$comment: Blueprint 3.7, 9.12 (Contract 9), 10.11 (Data Redaction Closure). Sole authoritative source for the closed Effect set, the Trust class list, the decision algebra dimensions/results/rules, approval-binding semantics, and the redaction-source registry. Only src/agentic_harness/_policy.py may decide a policy verdict, and src/agentic_harness/_classification.py may redact a value; both consult this document rather than a second hand-maintained copy. Resource kinds/shapes are owned by ResourceNormalization v1 (resource_normalization.schema.json), not duplicated here.
title: PolicyContract v1
description: Effect set, trust classes, decision algebra, approval binding, and redaction closure.

effects.description: 9.12.1/3.7, exact closed set. Unknown effects deny.

trust_classes.description: 3.7, exact closed set. Trust is provenance metadata, not a scalar permission score; no untrusted class can authorize an effect.

UntrustedTrustClass.description: 3.7/9.12.4: the subset of trust_classes that can never authorize an effect on its own.

dimensions.description: A policy decision evaluates the conjunction of these dimensions, exact order.

const: narrower scope wins over broader scope
unavailable enforcement yields BLOCKED_CAPABILITY, never an implicit widening
an approval can satisfy only an approval requirement already permitted by policy; it cannot override a hard deny
derived data inherits the maximum governing sensitivity/taint of its inputs until an explicit declassification mechanism exists; v1 defines no automatic declassification by summarization

binding_fields.description: An approval request binds to exactly these dimensions. Any material difference in any one requires a new approval (INV-APPROVAL-002).

allow_once_semantics.const: ALLOW_ONCE is consumed atomically immediately before the authorized side effect begins. A tool failure after consumption does not restore the grant.

allow_run_semantics.const: ALLOW_RUN remains usable until expiry/revocation but only for requests matching its explicit scope predicate.

rebinding_rule.const: any material difference in a binding field requires a new ApprovalRequest; no implicit reuse across a widened or altered request

pattern.description: Python `re` pattern recognizing this credential format's textual shape.

RedactionClosure.description: 10.11. V1 redaction combines deterministic structured redaction with exact-known-secret matching. Entropy-only detection is advisory and MUST NOT be the sole classification/redaction mechanism.

credential_formats.description: 10.11 source 3 ('registered credential formats required by enabled adapters'): the sole authoritative registry of recognized credential-string formats. src/agentic_harness/_classification.py loads this rather than hand-maintaining a second copy (Canonical Identity Rules).

derived_representation_rule.const: the broker may register deterministic derived representations of an exact secret (e.g. base64) only when the transformation is explicitly supported; unbounded transformation guessing is prohibited

redaction_points.description: 10.11: redaction occurs before every listed admission/egress point, exact set.

marker_format.description: Typed redaction marker replacing a matched secret value; field shape is preserved where practical. Redaction MUST NOT store plaintext and later 'clean' a projection (9.10.3/10.11).
